items.title: Prompt Enhancements & Refinements
items.description: Add specialized prompts for code review, linting, and security analysis. Create targeted prompts for common review tasks (security, performance, accessibility). Add templates for ESLint, Prettier, and PHPCS integration.
items.body:
## Objective

Add 5-7 specialized prompts for enhanced code review capabilities.

## Requirements

### 1. Security Code Review Prompt
- Specialized for OWASP vulnerability analysis
- Includes security checklist
- Detects common security patterns
- Effort: 30 min

### 2. Performance Review Prompt
- Analyzes code for performance issues
- Suggests optimization strategies
- Benchmarking recommendations
- Effort: 30 min

### 3. ESLint Auto-Fixer
- Generates ESLint configuration
- Creates custom rule prompts
- Auto-fix templates
- Effort: 20 min

### 4. Accessibility Audit Prompt
- WCAG 2.2 AA compliance checker
- Semantic HTML verification
- ARIA attribute guidance
- Effort: 20 min

### 5. PHP Linting Prompt
- PHPCS integration
- WordPress Coding Standards
- Common PHP issues detection
- Effort: 20 min

## Definition of Done

- [ ] 5-7 new prompts created
- [ ] All prompts in `prompts/` folder with `.prompt.md` naming
- [ ] Updated `prompts/PROMPTS-V1-INDEX.md` with new prompts
- [ ] Each prompt includes usage examples
- [ ] Markdown linting passes
- [ ] YAML frontmatter valid
- [ ] Prompt descriptions include effort estimates

## Acceptance Criteria

- Prompts are production-ready
- Clear documentation and examples
- Integration with existing prompt library
- All governance standards met

items.title: Prompt Automation Workflows
items.description: Create trigger-based prompt execution patterns. Build GitHub Actions workflows for running prompts on PR/issue events. Add CI/CD pipeline integration and scheduled execution templates.
items.body:
## Objective

Enable automated prompt execution through GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines.

## Requirements

### 1. GitHub Actions Workflow Templates
- Trigger prompts on PR events
- Trigger prompts on issue creation/update
- Result validation and comment posting
- Effort: 1 hour

### 2. CI/CD Pipeline Integration
- Pre-commit hook templates
- GitHub Actions reusable workflows
- Build pipeline prompt integration
- Effort: 1 hour

### 3. Scheduled Execution
- Cron-based prompt runners
- Daily/weekly analysis workflows
- Report generation templates
- Effort: 30 min

### 4. Prompt Chaining
- Sequential prompt execution
- Result passing between prompts
- Conditional execution logic
- Effort: 30 min

## Definition of Done

- [ ] 3-5 workflow templates created
- [ ] GitHub Actions examples in `workflows/` folder
- [ ] Pre-commit hook examples in `hooks/` folder
- [ ] Documentation with usage examples
- [ ] Tested with sample prompts
- [ ] Error handling and notifications
- [ ] All governance standards met

## Acceptance Criteria

- Workflows execute correctly
- Results properly formatted and posted
- Conditional logic working as specified
- Documentation clear and comprehensive

items.title: Prompt Versioning & Compatibility
items.description: Implement version control and backwards compatibility framework. Define version numbering scheme. Create compatibility matrix and deprecation procedures.
items.body:
## Objective

Implement versioning scheme and backwards compatibility management for prompts.

## Requirements

### 1. Version Numbering Scheme
- Define semantic versioning (semver) for prompts
- Version tracking in YAML frontmatter
- Migration guides for breaking changes
- Effort: 30 min

### 2. Compatibility Matrix
- Map prompt versions to feature support
- Document breaking changes
- Define deprecation timeline
- Effort: 30 min

### 3. Change Management
- CHANGELOG for prompts library
- Deprecation notice templates
- Rollback procedures
- Effort: 30 min

### 4. Backwards Compatibility Policy
- Support lifecycle documentation
- Major/minor/patch strategy
- Update procedures for users
- Effort: 30 min

## Definition of Done

- [ ] Version scheme documented in README
- [ ] All prompts include version in frontmatter
- [ ] CHANGELOG created and updated
- [ ] Compatibility matrix created
- [ ] Migration guides for major versions
- [ ] Policy documentation complete
- [ ] All governance standards met

## Acceptance Criteria

- Versioning scheme clear and easy to follow
- Compatibility matrix accurate and complete
- Deprecation procedures well-documented
- Users can easily identify breaking changes

items.title: Usage Analytics & Tracking
items.description: Implement telemetry and analytics framework. Track prompt usage and effectiveness. Build analytics dashboard for metrics visualization.
items.body:
## Objective

Implement usage tracking and analytics framework for the prompts library.

## Requirements

### 1. Telemetry Infrastructure
- Usage event schema definition
- Data collection pipeline
- Storage and aggregation
- Effort: 1 hour

### 2. Analytics Dashboard
- Prompt usage statistics
- Trend analysis and visualization
- Popularity rankings
- Effort: 1 hour

### 3. Feedback & Rating System
- User rating mechanism
- Feedback collection form
- Quality metrics calculation
- Effort: 30 min

### 4. Reporting Framework
- Weekly usage reports
- Adoption metrics
- Feedback summary reports
- Effort: 30 min

## Definition of Done

- [ ] Event schema documented
- [ ] Data collection implemented
- [ ] Dashboard created and functional
- [ ] Rating system integrated
- [ ] Reports generate automatically
- [ ] Privacy and compliance verified
- [ ] All governance standards met

## Acceptance Criteria

- Accurate usage tracking
- Clear and actionable dashboard
- Feedback mechanism working
- Reports providing useful insights

items.title: Prompt Discovery & Search
items.description: Build search and discovery interface for 113 prompts. Implement full-text search with faceted filtering. Create prompt recommendation engine.
items.body:
## Objective

Create comprehensive search and discovery interface for the prompts library.

## Requirements

### 1. Search Infrastructure
- Full-text search indexing
- Faceted search capability (category, tag, language)
- Fuzzy matching for typo tolerance
- Effort: 1 hour

### 2. Discovery Interface
- Web-based search UI
- Advanced filtering options
- Prompt previews and quick access
- Effort: 1 hour

### 3. Recommendation Engine
- Content-based recommendations
- Usage-based suggestions
- Role-specific recommendations
- Effort: 30 min

### 4. Integration Points
- Copilot Chat integration
- CLI search tool
- GitHub integration
- Effort: 30 min

## Definition of Done

- [ ] Search index created and working
- [ ] Discovery interface functional and tested
- [ ] Recommendations engine producing relevant results
- [ ] Integration with 2+ tools complete
- [ ] Documentation with usage examples
- [ ] Performance meets requirements (<100ms searches)
- [ ] All governance standards met

## Acceptance Criteria

- Fast and accurate search results
- Intuitive discovery interface
- Relevant recommendations
- Seamless integrations
